speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Metastatic Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Neck (likely from occult head and neck primary) or Metastatic Adenocarcinoma from Colon Cancer (via lymphatic spread to cervical nodes).

Given the patient's history of colon cancer and a progressive, painless neck mass over 2 months, this is highly suspicious for metastatic disease.
